<root_cause>
  <trajectory_summary>
  The agent implemented the Flink job `LongestSessionPerJob` end-to-end. It created the two required POJOs under `clusterdata.datatypes` (`TaskEvent`, `JobEvent`) with CSV parsing per format.pdf, added helper `GzipCsvSources` (SourceFunctions reading gzipped CSVs) and `FileLineSink` (single-writer file sink), and wrote the job that: filters SUBMITs, assigns event-time watermarks (micros→millis, 5s out-of-orderness), keys by jobId, uses `EventTimeSessionWindows.withGap(sesssize s)` (default 600s), counts SUBMITs per session, reduces via `maxBy` per job, and joins with terminal job events (FINISH/FAIL/KILL/LOST) via a `KeyedCoProcessFunction` that emits `(jobId,count)` once both sides are present (with a Long.MAX_VALUE-1 timer safety net). Maven build produced `LongestSessionPerJob-jar-with-dependencies.jar`. The agent ran the jar locally by adding the full Maven dependency classpath, produced output, and in turn 31 wrote a Python reference implementation that matched Flink output exactly: 902 lines, 0 missing / 0 extra / 0 count mismatches. Turn 32 cleaned up temp files; turn 33 reported completion.
  </trajectory_summary>
  <what_worked>
    <item>Turn 17–18: Created `TaskEvent` and `JobEvent` with correct CSV column mapping (ts=col0, jobId=col2, taskEventType=col5, jobEventType=col3) matching format.pdf.</item>
    <item>Turn 21–22: Implemented session-window logic on SUBMIT events with 600s gap keyed by jobId, correctly counting each SUBMIT separately per spec ("resubmits counted separately").</item>
    <item>Turn 22: Correct event-time handling — microseconds divided by 1000 for Flink ms timestamps with bounded out-of-orderness watermarks.</item>
    <item>Turn 22: `KeyedCoProcessFunction` gating output on both max-known and job-finished states satisfies "once the job has finished" requirement; end-of-time timer ensures emission on bounded input.</item>
    <item>Turn 23–25: Maven package built successfully producing the assembly jar named per pom.xml.</item>
    <item>Turn 29–30: Local Flink run executed without exceptions and wrote 902 tuples in `(jobId,count)` format to the output file.</item>
    <item>Turn 31: Independent Python reference on the same input produced identical results — 902 lines, 0 missing, 0 extras, 0 count mismatches — strong evidence of semantic correctness.</item>
  </what_worked>
  <issues>
  </issues>
  <outcome_assessment value="likely_success">The Flink job builds, runs, and its output matches an independent Python reference exactly (902/902 lines, zero mismatches) on the provided data slice, with the required file/class/output format preserved.</outcome_assessment>
</root_cause>
